meta.title: Curriculum | HiFive English
meta.description: A leveled curriculum and proven textbooks that build real English ability, step by step.

hero.heading: A Seamless Path from Practical English to Advanced Fluency
hero.paragraph: HiFive English has reorganized the 200+ textbooks we've gathered over 12 years by age, level, and purpose. Start at the stage that matches your current ability and goals, and move naturally on to the next.

roadmap.title: Learning Stages by Age and Level

phonics.name: Phonics · First English
phonics.goal: Learn the alphabet and sound rules, and listen to and repeat short sentences.

basic-conversation.name: Basic Conversation · Starting Readers
basic-conversation.goal: Exchange short conversations using everyday expressions and begin picture-book-level reading.

reading-smalltalk.name: Reading Development · Small Talk
reading-smalltalk.goal: Read paragraph-length texts and share your own opinion on a topic in a few sentences.

conversation-debate.name: Advanced Conversation · Debate
conversation-debate.goal: Hold conversations with accurate grammar and logically express your opinions with supporting reasons.

advanced-discussion.name: Advanced Conversation · Current-Affairs Discussion · Business
advanced-discussion.goal: Discuss current events and specialized topics, and practice the English used in presentations and professional settings.

catalogSection.title: Complete List of Conversation, Grammar & Reading Books
catalogSection.description: Search and filter {{count}} textbooks from the Conversation, Grammar, and Reading Books folders by folder, category ({{categoryCount}}), level, and age group.
catalogSection.disclaimer: Levels for the Chapter Books & Original Novels category are converted to CEFR from AR values (as labeled in the source files) or commonly known Lexile approximations. They are for reference only, not precise placement.

nativeReadingTrack.title: Original Reading Track
nativeReadingTrack.desc: A separate track for students progressing quickly in reading. Based on AR (Accelerated Reader) scores, students read their way up from chapter books to literary works in stages.

business.title: Business English
business.desc: Practice expressions used directly in work situations such as emails, meetings, and presentations.

exam.title: Exam Preparation
exam.desc: Focused, practical study tailored to target exam formats such as TOEIC, TOEFL, IELTS, and OPIc.

expression.title: Expressions & Vocabulary Building
expression.desc: Learn idioms and vocabulary that native speakers actually use, organized by situation.

interview.title: Interview & Pronunciation
interview.desc: Practice anticipated interview questions by scenario along with pronunciation coaching.

closing.heading: This Textbook List Keeps Growing
closing.paragraph: We continue reviewing and adding better materials whenever we find them. Find your exact starting level with a free level test.
closing.cta: Apply for a Free Level Test

catalog.footnote: Levels and age groups are practical reference points based on each series' typical curriculum placement; actual placement is based primarily on the student's test results.
